assumptions: SCALOP's v2019-10 clusters and PSSMs, as published in its repository.
The CDR is cut by SCALOP's own region tables in the chosen scheme and definition, which for North are not abnumber's.
limits: A class is a sequence-based prediction of a conformation, not a structure; a loop below the threshold, or of a length no cluster holds, gets no class.
CDR-H3 is not classified. T-cell receptor chains are refused.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which known loop conformation does each CDR of this antibody's variable domain most likely adopt?

description: Assign each CDR of an antibody heavy, kappa or lambda variable domain to its canonical structure class: SCALOP's length-independent clusters of known loop conformations (CDR-H1, H2, L1, L2, L3; H3 has no canonical classes). Each loop is scored against every cluster of its length by the cluster's position-specific log-odds; the best score above SCALOP's threshold names the class and its median structure (a PDB chain). Graded against the real SCALOP on every heavy, kappa and lambda chain of ANARCI's PDB benchmark.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

definition.description: where each CDR begins and ends, by SCALOP's own tables. Values: imgt (IMGT), chothia (Chothia), north (North).

protein.description: the protein sequence (one-letter amino acids); every heavy, kappa and lambda variable domain in it is classified.

scheme.description: the numbering the clusters are read in. Values: imgt (IMGT), chothia (Chothia).

species.description: species whose HMMs are preferred when numbering (ANARCI's default: human and mouse).

name: antibody_canonical_classes

classes.description: one `CDR: class` string per CDR, in sequence order (`H1: H1-13-A`, `None` where no class fits)

domains.description: per heavy, kappa or lambda domain: chain type, span, and per CDR the loop sequence, its class (cluster id), the median structure, the cluster's size, the outcome, SCALOP's threshold, every candidate cluster's score, and each residue's position, 0-based sequence index and log-odds in the assigned cluster
